scope: Provisional public TRAIN candidate in still-running Molt2 seed402, not final selection

designs.task: Write a new complete program that reuses the target's State/apply/produce/marginalValue helpers. Generate an initial valid length-T action sequence using the target's per-turn policy. Then run a time-bounded simulated-annealing/local search on the full sequence: repeatedly mutate by changing one action to a different valid action, swapping two adjacent actions, or moving an action to another turn; evaluate each mutation by exact forward simulation from the first changed turn, rejecting any sequence that makes apples negative; accept improvements and occasionally accept small worsening with a decreasing temperature. Keep the best valid sequence and output it.
designs.hypothesis: The incumbent makes irrevocable per-turn decisions via one-step rollout with a greedy marginal-ROI continuation; it cannot revise early commitments. A global local search over the entire 500-action sequence can coordinate upgrades across turns and escape the greedy local optimum.

interpretation: A full-sequence annealing redesign has improved on the completed controls for this seed; independent proposals, parent histories and allocation prevent isolating a framework effect from one seed.
